verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples. A community user mentions an OpenAPI spec, but a spec alone is not an interactive reference, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The Metrics API, SDK querying, CLI and MCP server are adjacent API features, not an explorable, runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
